title: Bryan Johnson Predicts The Year He Stops Aging
description:
Bryan Johnson believes we're the first generation that doesn’t have to die, and he has 1.5 billion data points on his own body to back it up. He shares the 5 free habits he believes beat any supplement, the year he predicts his aging stops, and why longevity may be the largest market in history: $1.2 quadrillion.

00:02:55 Selling Braintree for ~$1B and hitting rock bottom anyway
00:04:35 The year 2500 thought experiment
00:10:20 What humans actually value (and why it's killing us)
00:15:50 Why longevity could be a $1.2 quadrillion market
00:23:45 Entropy is the final boss
00:26:10 The one number that predicts your health
00:27:55 Bryan’s First Rule
00:32:30 Bryan’s Second Rule
00:34:35 Bryan’s Third Rule
00:37:00 Bryan’s Last Two Rules

00:45:40 1.5 billion data points and the 2039 prediction
00:49:30 Exercise without sleep? Think again.
00:52:15 "Don't Die": the friendliest ideology in history
00:56:35 The $1.2 quadrillion math
00:57:45 Bryan predicts his own (ironic) death
